slides.title: From kickoff to go-live in one quarter
slides.lead: We work in sprints. You see progress every two weeks, test early and approve each milestone before we move on.

stages.title: Capture & Connect
stages.text: We map your document types (delivery notes, invoices, customs forms), set up the AI capture engine and build the SAP connector. Your team reviews sample extractions.
stages.result: AI reads 95%+ of fields correctly, writes to SAP test system

stages.title: Triage & Validate
stages.text: We add e-mail classification (urgent / standard / spam) and validation rules (missing data, duplicate invoices). Your operations team tests the workflow in a sandbox.
stages.result: E-mails routed automatically, exceptions flagged for review

stages.title: Train & Go Live
stages.text: We train your team (2-day workshop in Hannover), run parallel processing for 2 weeks, then switch to production. Borek support stays on standby for 4 weeks.
stages.result: Full automation live, 3 hours per day saved per employee

panel.text: Document capture API, SAP integration module, e-mail triage rules, validation library, user documentation, 2-day on-site training, 4 weeks hypercare support.

slides.note: Timeline assumes requirements sign-off by end of November and SAP test access in week 1
